question: Find the value of (1-cot ² theta)/(tan ²theta-1)
solution:
**Given:**

(1-cot ² θ)/(tan ²θ-1)

**Formula Used:**

Cotθ = Cosθ/Sinθ 

Tanθ = Sinθ/Cosθ 

**Calculation:**

(1-cot ² θ)/(tan ²θ-1)

⇒ {1 - (Cosθ/Sinθ)²}/{(Sinθ/Cosθ)² - 1)}

⇒ {(Sin²θ - Cos²θ )/Sin²θ /(Sin2θ - Cos2θ )/ Cos²θ)

⇒ Cos2θ/ Sin2θ 

⇒ Cot2 θ

**∴ The correct answer is cot2 θ.**
